title: Specter v2
description: The hero a bot was assigned and the avatar it shows. Every bot binding has exactly one hero, assigned automatically the first time the binding appears and never changed, reclaimed or edited: heroId, ordinal, name, epithet, personality and appearance are fixed authored content, not generated, and imply no role, capability or lane. displayName is name for ordinal 1 and name plus a Roman numeral from ordinal 2 (digits above 3999); the client never composes it. bindingId is the only reference to the bot (the bot-binding contract's opaque id, never a Crew id). version is the avatar revision, 0 when the user has never changed the avatar; a client sends it back as expectedVersion on POST /api/specters/{bindingId}/portrait and a mismatch is a 409. portrait is always present: the hero's own bundled portrait when avatarChosen is false, otherwise the avatar the user picked; the embedded portrait always has dataBase64 null. source is always roster. A Specter is cosmetic: nothing here is an agent setting, permission, experience value or level.
